title: MOSAIC 2.0: Modular, Open-Source Suite for Assistive Intelligent Control
description: MOSAIC is a modular, open-source software suite for real-time biosignal processing and assistive intelligent control. It supports visual construction of acquisition, signal-processing, machine-learning, visualization, recording, and device-control pipelines.
